title: wake phrase chime, counters and second check (experimental)

clauses.text: A chime plays when the wake phrase is heard

steps.do: With My IYAKKI on, say the phrase.
steps.expect: A chime plays when it hears you.

clauses.text: The second check accepts the phrase only when it is heard clearly

steps.do: Turn on the second check (Settings, Voice, key T). Say the phrase clearly, then say it mumbled or different.
steps.expect: The clear phrase wakes it. The mumbled or different phrase is dropped.
